description: Gutted C-47/DC-3 hulk, formerly stored at Gómez Carreño (Viña del Mar), painted copper-colour with Codelco División Andina sponsorship and set on a concrete plinth at the rodeo ground (medialuna) of San Esteban near Los Andes; no data plate or interior survives, so its identity is unknown (modocharlie.com, May 2012). Presence after 2012 not confirmed.
museum_name: Medialuna de San Esteban C-47 Monument, Los Andes
